# Krystal Loop Protocol

> Krystal Loop Protocol (KLP) is a loop for AI coding work with a one-command runner: a low-cost model builds the change in a sandbox, the runner executes the declared checks, a frontier model from a different family reviews the exact diff, each finding is confirmed or discarded by running a probe test, confirmed findings get a bounded repair, and the run ends with a patch and a receipt. On a public 66-task benchmark it solved 59 tasks at $0.046 a task against 56 at $0.721 for gpt-6-astra alone. The Semiotic Protocol (Semio) carries coordination between several agents as typed messages; on 30 pairs of conflicting features it delivered the same 28 pairs as agent chat with 333 model calls in place of 581. Every published figure recomputes offline with `python3 -m bench.verify`. Licence: the software is free for individuals and small businesses (PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0), anyone may evaluate it and rerun the benchmarks, and larger organisations need a commercial licence; the documentation is CC-BY-4.0.
